description: --system scopes the export to one system's concepts and mapping rows: two `TRIAGE_SE` runs are byte-identical, the manifest reconciles, and the concept count is the census pin for `TRIAGE_SE` (29 concepts, none `OMOP_EXT`-bound); `TRIAGE_SE`'s mapping targets are plain external codes, which the contract never uses as ids, so CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP is empty under this filter — a pin of the external-code skip rule itself; the Athena invariants hold over the scoped population without the whole-tree reconciliation
